answer: Anyone running 91 aliases therefore needs 82 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in dune, expire in vine, and velvet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1379 identities would post 4987 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
